about_the_game:
Inspired by the chilling real-life Hinterkaifeck murders of 1922, it places you in the shoes of a young maid arriving at a remote German farmhouse on the very day the family vanished.

You just got employed to work as a maid in a rich family's house. You got there and were introduced and shown around the house, so excited, finally got a job, didn't know what the next few hours would mean, only to sleep, woke up to the hit to her head, and never woke up again. Play the chance she never had, investigators, help us get closer to the unsolved case, and help us get closure to this case. THE  INVESTIGATION DOESN'T HAPPEN DURING THE GAMEPLAY, BUT AFTER THE GAME. 

Nightfall is not just any horror game. It's a call-up game designed around the story of this case, which was never solved, and I decided to bring it back to the smarter we now, advanced tech. Maybe we might get closer to a better conclusion because it remains confusing to me.

ᴋᴇʏ ꜰᴇᴀᴛᴜʀᴇꜱ

  • Choice-driven: 2 choices, 2 different outcomes

  • Sheesh: No noise, the killer hears you. Pray the plates don't tell on you.

  • Interactive environment: Looking for weapons or survival tools, the drawers have them. manually moving doors to add fun.

  • Life or death decision: with a time in your hand, decide to flee with the last survivor or flee alone.

  • stealth & survival: Hide while the killer is close or sneak on the killer and stab him to death.

  • Unique Atmosphere: chosen Black and white to relive the vintage times.

  • Multiple Ending: with 2 different endings, helping to give the what-if situation.

Will you survive the night and see my own opinion? It might help you get closer to what I could not find.

Spread the unsolved case.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes and imagery that may not be suitable for all audiences.
It includes:

Depictions of violence and murder, presented in a stylized black-and-white visual style.

Disturbing imagery and psychological horror involving fear, pursuit, and death.

References to family tragedy and loss.

Mild blood effects and scenes of characters in danger.

There are no explicit sexual scenes or nudity.
All disturbing content is used for storytelling purposes related to a historical mystery and not for shock or exploitation.

name: NIGHTFALL: The Farmhouse Murders

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for low-to-mid hardware from 2013 or newer. Runs best on SSD for faster scene transitions.

short_description: Inspired by the unsolved Hinterkaifeck murders of 1922, NIGHTFALL: The Farmhouse Murders is a black-and-white psychological horror set on a remote German farm where an entire family was mysteriously killed. Step into the role of a new maid arriving on the day everything went wrong.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
